producer: Each emitting checked build publishes NAME.build-archive.json with the exact observed graph and every listed source, compiler-entry, static-host-source, admissions, implementation, acceptance-context, pass-definition, action, execution and target-output byte snapshot. The receipt binds both graph and archive identities and is published last. Check-only mode still returns a receipt without claiming an emission archive.
format: Canonical single-file JSON, sorted unique domain/contract-qualified ArtifactIds and canonical base64 bytes. No filesystem paths are extracted; graph source locations are informational only.

consumerPolicy.irValidation: Optional caller-selected configuration: absolute binary/cwd, expectedBinaryId, optional env and resource limits. Never loaded from the archive; every retained verified/specialized IR subject must replay or verification fails closed.

run: pscv-verify --build-archive NAME.build-archive.json --policy TRUSTED_LOCAL_POLICY; the standalone distribution additionally requires --manifest-sha256 INDEPENDENTLY_PINNED_HASH
verification: Bound input before copying, parse canonical UTF-8 JSON, reject duplicate/order/schema violations and noncanonical base64.
Rehash every archived artifact, require the independently selected graph and exactly its listed artifact set.
Bind inline structured records to their bytes and require every declared ArtifactId reference to resolve.

Recompute each pass action, definitions, implementation identity, input/output contracts, fingerprints and allowed assumptions with the existing pass verifier. Unsupported evidence checkers are not loaded from the archive.

When irValidation is explicitly requested, preflight canonical closed IR, pin validator bytes before/after execution and freshly run strict validation. Missing subjects reject; unsupported external link context, exhaustion and infrastructure failure cannot become acceptance.
result: Default Accepted means observed-artifact-integrity-only. Explicit successful closed-IR replay adds closedIrInvariantsVerified and its individual exact subject/validator identities. fullInputClosureEstablished, semanticClaimsVerified, preservationVerified and releaseAccepted remain false. No live checked compiler handle is created; only the independently selected validator may be executed.
remaining: discover and bind complete generated compiler, provider, runtime and TypeScript input/tool closure
hostile-host isolation and full resource accounting
linked-module IR invariant replay and validator soundness

producerResourcePolicy.defaults: Existing limits are unchanged; no automatic growth from observed input sizes or compiler/provider choice.
producerResourcePolicy.snapshot: Only own integer data properties are accepted and frozen before source/compiler loading.
producerResourcePolicy.record: The receipt records selected producer limits descriptively; an archive verifier always applies its independently selected consumer limits.
producerResourcePolicy.preflight: Count and aggregate/per-artifact byte checks precede any base64 conversion. Exact canonical archive byte size is preflighted from the empty-data skeleton plus base64 lengths.
producerResourcePolicy.exhaustion: Typed resource, observed, limit and responsible ArtifactId where applicable; no captured input is omitted and no partial receipt is published.
producerResourcePolicy.nativeIntegration: The cloud two-native-binary integration explicitly selects 320 MiB aggregate and 448 MiB encoded archive bounds, retaining the 128 MiB per-artifact default. This is resource policy, not weakened semantic or self-host acceptance.
